question_template: For a {household_type} household with citizenship {citizenship}, first-timer status {first_timer}, youngest applicant aged {age} and average gross monthly household income of {household_income}, is the household eligible for the Enhanced CPF Housing Grant, and which EHG amount applies?

overview.quote: From 20 August 2024, first-timer families may qualify for an EHG of up to $120,000, while a couple comprising a first-timer and second-timer may qualify for an EHG (Singles) of up to $60,000.
